item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03555","case1_error":"Reports one shortened segment’s length, 5 inches, instead of the joined three-segment rope’s length, 15 inches.","case2_error":"Uses 40 situps as 40 minutes instead of deriving 10 minutes; final 150 also lacks support from the displayed expressions.","reason":"The first answers an intermediate quantity; the second confuses a repetition count with elapsed time and supplies an unsupported total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03556","case1_error":"Counts only 10 ads instead of the three companies’ combined 30 ads, omitting the factor of three.","case2_error":"Subtracts money from length, then writes an expression evaluating to 4000 while reporting 10000.","reason":"The first omits a required multiplicity. The second contains invalid quantity relations and a final number inconsistent with its expression, regardless of field-size interpretation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03557","case1_error":"Doubles the second country’s stay to obtain the third’s, although both should be twice the first country’s stay.","case2_error":"Mislabels per-builder productivity as team productivity and uses half that rate as time instead of taking the reciprocal of the doubled rate.","reason":"The first applies a comparison to the wrong baseline; the second confuses individual and team rates and incorrectly converts rate into duration.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03558","case1_error":"Omits the ten additional Saturday rounds from the weekend total.","case2_error":"Counts grooming time for only one dog, omitting the second dog’s grooming throughout the month.","reason":"Both correctly calculate time for an incomplete set of required activities, omitting explicitly specified contributions to the total.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03559","case1_error":"Changes four aunts to three and substitutes Iris for her brother in the attendance count.","case2_error":"Divides the daily round-trip distance by five, incorrectly treating it as a weekly distance before calculating monthly mileage.","reason":"The first alters the stated people being counted; the second introduces an unjustified division when converting commute distance to a daily quantity.","judgment":"different"}]}
